name: snRNA-seq of human optic nerve and optic nerve head - endothelial cells
description: We identified 7 cell types/states of endothelial cells from over 10,000 snRNA-seq cells derived from human optic nerve and optic nerve head.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: We used scVI for data integration and then manually annotated each cell cluster with scanpy based on marker gene expression.

labels.name: Venule_postcapillary
labels.rationale: An endothelial cell sub class that expresses PKHD1L1 and MMRN1

labels.name: Capillary_fenestrated
labels.rationale: An endothelial sub class that expresses PLVAP, CA4, and BTNL9

labels.name: Capillary
labels.rationale: An endothelial sub class that expresses BTNL9 but not PLVAP or CA4.

labels.name: Vein/Venule
labels.rationale: An endothelial cell sub class that expresses CDH11

labels.name: Venule_POSTN+
labels.rationale: An endothelial cell sub class that expresses POSTN

labels.name: Artery/Arteriole
labels.rationale: An endothelial cell sub class that expresses VEGFC and PCSK5

labels.name: Venule_dysfunction
labels.rationale: An endothelial cell sub class that expresses TMSB10
